notes: Saying the colour looks wrong now fixes the colour. "The colours look faded", "the picture looks dull" and "it looks lifeless" used to reach nothing at all — the same complaint written the other way round, "faded colours", had always worked, which is a distinction no one should have to know. Asking for the look on purpose still applies it: "give it a faded look" and "make it muted" take the colour down, exactly as before.
